title: Admonitions of the Instructress to the Court Ladies (Admonitions Scroll)
summary: The Admonitions Scroll is a Chinese handscroll illustrating a text by Zhang Hua, with nine surviving scenes out of an original twelve. It is attributed to the painter Gu Kaizhi, but the British Museum object record and Google Arts & Culture describe the scroll as a later work, a Tang-period copy in the latter.

uncertainty.note: The British Museum production field gives '344-405 (Gu Kaizhi)', the attributed painter's dates, not the scroll's own date; Google Arts & Culture calls the surviving scroll a Tang Dynasty copy, so the surviving object is probably later.

importance.justification: A famous handscroll attributed to Gu Kaizhi, illustrating Zhang Hua's text on court conduct; the pin shows only its present holding place (British Museum).
